audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer names abilities Aurora does not have. spikes[0] calls her poke 'Sadness' and her kit 'Blight-adjacent'; spikes[1] calls her ultimate 'The Weight of Sorrow'; spikes[3], early and wants.foe[0] describe a 'passive slow' and 'Sadness debuffs'. spikes[2] and wants.you[1] also mis-slot Between Worlds as her dash escape — that is Across the Veil (W).
audit.why: Riot's slots are Spirit Abjuration (P, a HEAL from exorcised spirits), Twofold Hex (Q, 900 range, recastable), Across the Veil (W, leap plus invisibility), The Weirding (E, damage and slow with a backward hop), Between Worlds (R). Her passive heals; it does not slow.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..3], early, mid, late, wants.you[0], wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], wants.foe[2] rewritten against the real kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The difficulty case never named the range gap or the recast, which is what actually decides the early lane.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is 900 range against Null Sphere's 650, and the recast 'draws active curses back toward herself, damaging foes hit along the way' — so retreating through the curse line takes the second hit.
audit.corrected: enemyWin, dontsFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, tradeBad and phases[1].why now state it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Kassadin clock line and no field priced Across the Veil's cooldown, which is the only window Kassadin gets.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18 — over 20 seconds at rank 1 during which she has no escape. Between Worlds is 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, breakdown.carry, ahead, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and phases[5].why keyed to 22 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Abjuration heals her off everything she damages, and no field on the page mentioned it or anti-heal.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal; Riot: 'Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.' Chip damage does not stick against that.
audit.corrected: breakdown.late, breakdown.feeding, ahead, breakdown.mid and early now say it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18, Twofold Hex 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, The Weirding 15/14/13/12/11, Between Worlds 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: All four written in with ranges.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 lint findings: Aurora repeatedly called he/his/him, plus dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles. breakdown.late and spikes[3] also invoke a Null Sphere 'silence'.
audit.why: Aurora is she/her per champ-gender.js. Riot gives Null Sphere channel interruption, not a silence. Between Worlds is hard CC and will cancel your Q instead.
